answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist Sybil attacks is by mandating a unique computational relic for each new identity, such as a modest proof-of-work challenge that must be solved before joining. This raises the cost of creating fake accounts, much like requiring each participant to carve their own umber seal from rare digital stone. The resulting lotus of verified effort per agent discourages mass farming while keeping the barrier low for genuine participants who contribute real value.
